offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures EPA and CARB certified industrial engines, generator sets and fuel systems that run on propane, natural gas, gasoline or diesel. Sells mainly to equipment makers and integrators, who install them in forklifts, generators and other machines, and supports them with aftermarket parts.

primary_products.value: engines; generator sets; fuel systems; aftermarket parts

primary_services.value: aftermarket parts and service; custom engineering and integration

customer_segment.value: B2B: equipment manufacturers, generator set builders, material handling OEMs, vehicle and industrial equipment makers

end_markets.value: material handling; power generation; industrial equipment; transportation; oil and gas

revenue_model.value: product sales: engines, generator sets and fuel systems sold to OEM customers; service fees: aftermarket parts, technical support and custom engineering work

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds engines and generator sets from purchased components, sold to equipment makers and integrators

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with some sales to customers in other countries

specialization.value: related lines: engines, generator sets and fuel systems, all sharing alternative fuel engine technology and OEM customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to OEM customers and large accounts; distributors / dealers: independent distributors and dealers for parts and service

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: engines must meet EPA and California Air Resources Board emissions certification rules

notes: Product mix and geographic split of sales may have changed; details are based on general knowledge of the company.
